Subject: Release readout: Nov quarter product/eng status & critical risks

Team — attaching the pre-read for Thursday's leadership rehearsal with Acme (see Drive link below). Key ask: please review the Risk Register tab and the gating criteria in the API freeze checklist before EOD Monday so I can consolidate into the external readout.

High-level summary:
- Ship target: Nov 30 production push (staggered rollout, see timeline).
- Major features: Streaming latency improvements, Dedicated autoscaling controls, and private deployment initial alpha.
- Top engineering risks (short): DB migration performance, model-quantization perf regression, infra autoscaler stability under burst.

Immediate asks:
1) Markus — confirm whether the migration window can be shortened to 2 hours without manual rollback (owner: markus).
2) Ava — outline the E2E test scope for private alpha and whether we need extra cycles with Acme next week (owner: ava).
3) Laura — pricing/legal flags for a potential SLA credit if rollout slips past Dec 7 (owner: laura).
4) Dev — prioritize the API contract freeze checklist items flagged as critical (owner: dev).

Attachments (stubs): risk_register_v2.xlsx (see tab: Risks/Gating), release_timeline_v3.png, api_freeze_checklist.pdf

Drive pre-read: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/release-readout-2026Q4
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-1129

Thanks — will synthesize responses and propose firm asks for leadership rehearsal on Wednesday at 11:00 PST.

— Karthik

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, cloud-sales@cloudco.com
Date: 2026-11-15T13:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Release readout: Nov quarter product/eng status & critical risks

Looping in a short technical update and what I uploaded to the Risk Register (see attached spreadsheet). TL;DR on the migration and autoscaler:
- DB migration: we have a plan to parallelize index rebuilds; estimated window 3.5 hours with current infra. I can get it down to ~2 hours but it requires a small rollback automation (I marked as blocked until SRE has a runbook).
- Model quantization: early perf regressions on long-context workloads observed in the 8-bit path. Mitigation: fall back to 16-bit for affected model slices until we finish micro-benchmarks. This adds cost but lowers risk.
- Autoscaler: saw a spike that caused pod churn during last stress test; root cause tracked to a race in the scale-down path. Patch scheduled for Nov 26.

I've attached an excerpt from our perf tests and a short note on the rollback automation we need. If we can't deliver rollback automation by Nov 23, recommend shifting the production push to Dec 6 to allow an extra stabilization window.

Attachments (stubs): risk_register_v2.xlsx (rows 12-26 updated), perf_excerpts.log

— Markus
Markus Klein
Director of Engineering
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-15T16:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Release readout: Nov quarter product/eng status & critical risks

Thanks for the pre-read. Quick notes from QA/Platform perspective:
- Private alpha: we currently have 3 critical E2E scenarios missing (data ingress validation under high concurrency, rolling updates with KV cache warm-start, and customer-specific RBAC smoke). I estimate two extra sprints (3 weeks) to close with confidence if we include Acme in early smoke tests.
- Suggestion: run a targeted alpha with Acme in a staging region the week of Nov 29 — that gives us two weeks before the Nov 30 push to verify rollout scripts and migration plan.
- Test owners: I've assigned leads in the shared doc; will follow up with a one-pager test plan by Monday.

One operational ask for Acme: we need a short, signed confirmation on their inbound test data retention limits to ensure our private alpha doesn't retain PII longer than they allow. Olivia — can you confirm?

Ava Chen
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform

Subject: Re: Release readout: Nov quarter product/eng status & critical risks — decisions & next steps

Thanks for the quick turn. Summary and leadership asks for rehearsal:
- Migration window: Markus to accelerate rollback automation; if automation is completed by Nov 23 we keep Nov 30. If not, we shift production push to Dec 6 (decision point: Nov 24).
- Private alpha: Ava to run targeted alpha with Acme the week of Nov 29. Olivia — please confirm data retention limits by Monday EOD (Nov 16).
- SLA exposure: Laura to provide estimated credit exposure (ballpark) by EOD Monday; we'll include as a contingency line in the external deck.
- API freeze: Dev to deliver contract-freeze status and a one-paragraph mitigation note by Monday morning.

I'll fold these updates into the public rehearsal deck and propose a 25-minute leader-run rehearsal on Wednesday 11:00 PST (internal-only) followed by a 45-minute external rehearsal with Acme on Thursday 10:00 PST.

If anything material changes, flag on this thread. Otherwise I'll circulate the revised deck Tue evening.

— Karthik
VP Product Operations, Redwood Inference
